_doc: Elites (0.3.3): an existing monster plus one or more words, Diablo-style, using the player's own keyword vocabulary. The monster keeps its own behaviour; each word adds one trait. base applies to every elite. patrols and ley_waves say when they appear and how many words they roll. Numbers are first-pass, deliberately large; tune freely. Element words do something (small, element-coloured versions of the wizard's own spells, always telegraphed): FIERY calls down a meteor on you (warning, impact, burning ground), ICY winds up and throws a fan of ice shards at you when you are close, SHOCKING calls a warned lightning strike on you, IRON is armoured; each touch also puts its status on you (player_statuses). Their spells are data/spells/elite_*.json, cast through the same spell engine as yours. Ley guardians, bosses, more cast words and learning a word from a defeated elite are later work (doc 15). color: an element word's colour for the elite's name and its spells' telegraphs. windup: seconds the elite charges (a visible glow) before the spell leaves. max_words caps how many words any rolled elite carries (one for now, so each elite does one readable thing; raise it and add patrol word tiers to bring back two-word elites).

player_statuses._doc: Statuses monsters put on the player (elite contact and elite spells). Slows stack as the strongest one.
